Let the original square have side length \(4\) units (the scale does not matter).

- After the two folds, the cuts are made along the midlines of the folded square.

- Four corner pieces of size \(1\times1\), which are squares.
- Four side pieces of size \(1\times2\) or \(2\times1\), which are not squares.
- One central piece of size \(2\times2\), which is a square.

4+1=5.
